$comment: ★★ A PROGRAM WITH A THREAD-LOCAL LINKS BESIDE A STATIC LIBRARY'S MEMBER ON EVERY FORMAT (P69 round 4, D-LK-PE-THREAD-LOCAL-PROGRAM-REFUSED-BESIDE-ANY-OTHER-UNIT). Each target's `dependsOn` builds `dsslib.c` — an ordinary read of the program's ordinary `shared` — into a DSS static library; main.c has a thread-local of its own, `t`, and returns `t + read_shared()`. A PE thread-local is read through the image's `_tls_index`, a symbol the PE WRITER defines and every unit names by one reserved id; the cross-unit merge remapped that id to a fresh one no writer binds, and the multi-unit resolver did not exempt it as the single-unit path does, so ✔MEASURED 2026-10-07 before this round's fix (`.orchestrators/p69/work/xa/r4tls/fixtures/probe_tls_plus_member.log`, the worktree's Windows debug dsscp): the pe64 arm was REFUSED, `K_SymbolUndefined` 'relocation in CU #1 targets symbol #4294967041 which is not defined or imported in that CompilationUnit', while the same main.c ALONE linked, and the ELF x86_64, ELF aarch64 and Mach-O arm64 arms linked with the member (their thread-local access names no writer-reserved id). The references link the same two files and run them to 42 (✔MEASURED 2026-10-07): cl 19.44 objects linked by link.exe 14.44 and by lld-link 19.1.5 against `lib`'s archive of the member (`.orchestrators/p69/work/xa/r4probe/m12`, `m12/m12-run.log`), and gcc 13.3.0 with GNU ld 2.42, natively on x86_64 and as the aarch64 cross under qemu-aarch64, at -O0 and -O2, PIE and not, the member archived alone with ar, 8 of 8 (`r4probe/m13`). What each value proves by the exit code: 42 = 35 + 7 only if `t`'s read reached this thread's copy and the member's read reached `shared`. The Mach-O arm64 arm runs on the darwin leg. The `release` arm builds the archive and main through the shipped release pipeline.
